Seafood & Vegetable Tempura: Medium to large shrimp, shelled, leaving tails on, deveined and butter filed or. Fish fillets cut into 1 inches x 2 inches pieces or. Scallops, halved if large, or. Combination of shrimp, fish and scallops. Green bell pepper, seeds removed and cut into 1 inches x 2 inches pieces. Sweet potato peeled and cut crosswise into 1/4 inches thick slices. Large Japanese eggplant trimmed and cut on diagonal into 1/4 inches thick slices. Green beans, broccoli, or asparagus tips, trimmed and cut into bite size pieces. Frying Oil: Pour vegetable oil for frying, at lasts 2 inch deep, in large pot, deep frying pan, or wok. Heat to 350 degrees F. Tempura Batter: Pour 2-1/4 cups ice cold water into large mixing bowl. Sprinkle entire contents of Dynasty Gluten-Free Tempura Batter Mix over water. With wire whisk or chopsticks, stir in mix only until mix is moistened and large lumps disappear. Batter should be very lumpy. Drop in one ice cube. Do not stir batter after mixing. Directions for Frying: To fry shrimp, hold one at a time, by the tail, and dip into batter. Drain off excess batter slightly and gently slide into hot oil. Repeat with 3 or 4 more shrimps and a few batter dipped vegetables. Fry until light golden brown. Remove from oil: drain briefly on paper towel. Keep warm. Skim pieces of cooked batter from oil with wire strainer. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Serve tempura with tempura dipping sauce. Tempura Dipping Sauce: For 4 servings, combine 1/4 cup Kikkoman Tempura dipping sauce with 1-1/4 cups hot water. Serve in small individual bowls. Or, dip in Dynasty sweet & sour or plum sauces, as desired.

Frying Oil: Pour vegetable oil for frying, at lasts 2 inch deep, in large pot, deep frying pan, or wok. Heat to 350 degrees F. Tempura Batter: Pour 2-1/4 cups ice cold water into large mixing bowl. Sprinkle entire contents of Dynasty Gluten-Free Tempura Batter Mix over water. With wire whisk or chopsticks, stir in mix only until mix is moistened and large lumps disappear. Batter should be very lumpy. Drop in one ice cube. Do not stir batter after mixing. Directions for Frying: To fry shrimp, hold one at a time, by the tail, and dip into batter. Drain off excess batter slightly and gently slide into hot oil. Repeat with 3 or 4 more shrimps and a few batter dipped vegetables. Fry until light golden brown. Remove from oil: drain briefly on paper towel. Keep warm. Skim pieces of cooked batter from oil with wire strainer. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Serve tempura with tempura dipping sauce. Tempura Dipping Sauce: For 4 servings, combine 1/4 cup Kikkoman Tempura dipping sauce with 1-1/4 cups hot water. Serve in small individual bowls. Frying Oil: Pour vegetable oil for frying, at lasts 2 inch deep, in large pot, deep frying pan, or wok. Heat to 350 degrees F. Tempura Batter: Pour 2-1/4 cups ice cold water into large mixing bowl. Sprinkle entire contents of Dynasty Gluten-Free Tempura Batter Mix over water. With wire whisk or chopsticks, stir in mix only until mix is moistened and large lumps disappear. Batter should be very lumpy. Drop in one ice cube. Do not stir batter after mixing. Directions for Frying: To fry shrimp, hold one at a time, by the tail, and dip into batter. Drain off excess batter slightly and gently slide into hot oil. Repeat with 3 or 4 more shrimps and a few batter dipped vegetables. Fry until light golden brown. Remove from oil: drain briefly on paper towel. Keep warm. Skim pieces of cooked batter from oil with wire strainer. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Serve tempura with tempura dipping sauce. Tempura Dipping Sauce: For 4 servings, combine 1/4 cup Kikkoman Tempura dipping sauce with 1-1/4 cups hot water. Serve in small individual bowls. Master tea makers for over 300 years. Since 1690. Perfecting the art of tea. Impeccable quality is the hallmark of this fine tea, made with 100% Japanese Sencha tea. With its pale green liquor and fresh, flowery taste it is the tea most favored in Japanese homes, enjoyed especially as a relaxing afternoon drink. Coming out of the temple gate, the song of the pickers: it is Japan!  In 1690, Japan was ruled by the Tokugawa Shogunate, the Manchus had repelled the Mongols, Louis XIV ruled in splendor from his palace at Versailles, Csar Peter had just attained the throne and Johann Sebastian Bach was 5 years old. That same year in Japan the Yamamoto Family opened a tea shop in Edo. More than 3 centuries of experience go into the selection and processing of Yamamotoyama teas, among the very finest in the world. This premium whole leaf tea is delicately packaged in a biodegradable pyramid-shaped mesh tea bag that allows the tea leaves and ingredients room to fully infuse, resulting in a truly exceptional cup of tea. 100% natural ingredients.
Japanese Sencha Green Tea Leaf

To savor the full flavor of this exquisite tea, bring fresh water to a rolling boil. Cool to recommended temperature and pour directly over the tea bag in a pre-heated cup. Brew 3-5 minutes (or to desired taste) at 158 degrees F (70 degrees C). One tea bag makes 8 ounces.

Seafood & Vegetable Tempura: Medium to large shrimp, shelled, leaving tails on, deveined and butter filed or. Fish fillets cut into 1 inches x 2 inches pieces or. Scallops, halved if large, or. Combination of shrimp, fish and scallops. Green bell pepper, seeds removed and cut into 1 inches x 2 inches pieces. Sweet potato peeled and cut crosswise into 1/4 inches thick slices. Large Japanese eggplant trimmed and cut on diagonal into 1/4 inches thick slices. Green beans, broccoli, or asparagus tips, trimmed and cut into bite size pieces. Frying Oil: Pour vegetable oil for frying, at lasts 2 inch deep, in large pot, deep frying pan, or wok. Heat to 350 degrees F. Tempura Batter: Pour 2-1/4 cups ice cold water into large mixing bowl. Sprinkle entire contents of Dynasty Gluten-Free Tempura Batter Mix over water. With wire whisk or chopsticks, stir in mix only until mix is moistened and large lumps disappear. Batter should be very lumpy. Drop in one ice cube. Do not stir batter after mixing. Directions for Frying: To fry shrimp, hold one at a time, by the tail, and dip into batter. Drain off excess batter slightly and gently slide into hot oil. Repeat with 3 or 4 more shrimps and a few batter dipped vegetables. Fry until light golden brown. Remove from oil: drain briefly on paper towel. Keep warm. Skim pieces of cooked batter from oil with wire strainer. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Serve tempura with tempura dipping sauce. Tempura Dipping Sauce: For 4 servings, combine 1/4 cup Kikkoman Tempura dipping sauce with 1-1/4 cups hot water. Serve in small individual bowls. Or, dip in Dynasty sweet & sour or plum sauces, as desired.
